Priya: Quick design question — should Dedicated tenants be allowed to fall back to hosted when their reserved GPU pool is saturated? Thinking a per-tenant console flag (allow_fallback) + rollout controls. We need to balance isolation vs availability.

Liam: My gut: default = false for Dedicated. Isolation + compliance reasons. But allow opt-in for non-sensitive customers or internal teams. SLAs need to be explicit. :warning:

Sam: We can avoid immediate hosted spillover by doing ordered fallbacks: prefer compatible model variants on Dedicated (quantized/FP16) before hitting hosted. Proposal for routing policy header: `X-Fallback-Policy`. Example config: 
```
fallback_policy: [
  {type: "variant", prefer: ["quantized-v2","fp16"]},
  {type: "hosted", allow_if: "tenant.allow_fallback == true"}
]
```
This keeps isolation tighter and reduces hosted costs.

Maya: Telemetry we need: `routing.fallback.count`, `tenant.isolation.violations`, `routing.latency.delta_ms`, and `billing.hosted.spillover_tokens`. Customers on SOC2/PCL can't opt-in unless contract allows. We should tag traces with tenant_id + spillover_reason.

Priya: For Console UX: a clear toggle per-tenant — "Allow hosted fallback" with a canary slider (0-100%). Rollouts page should show traffic_pct and historical spillover rate. UI copy: "Allow requests to route to Redwood-hosted model variants when Dedicated capacity is unavailable".

Liam: Billing question — how do we invoice spillover tokens? Attach hosted usage to tenant account (avoid double-billing). Also need clear dashboard column `spillover_cost` so Sales/Fin can reconcile.

Sam: Implementation notes: router needs deterministic priority + fallback attempts. We should emit header on proxied requests: `X-Route-Decision: dedicated->hosted` and include `X-Fallback-Path: variant,hosted`. Example log line: `INFO routing: tenant=acme-corp decision=hosted reason=dedicated_full latency_delta_ms=45 spillover_tokens=124`. Also set Sentry tag `spillover=true`.

EVA-Bot: Canary rollout started for tenant=acme-corp flag=allow_fallback=true pct=5 started_at=1859994380

Maya: Also add alerting: if `routing.fallback.count` / requests > 0.01 for 10m => notify eng-platform and page on 0.05. Add one-click drilldown from tenant page to the per-route traces.

Priya: TL;DR next steps — default to false, support opt-in per-tenant with canary slider, prefer model-variant fallback path before hosted, add telemetry + billing tags, and update rollouts UX. I'll draft a short RFC and example console mockups. Thanks all :+1:
